sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: Let $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\1&\alpha\end{bmatrix}$ and $B=\begin{bmatrix}3&3\\\beta&2\end{bmatrix}$. If $A^2-4A+I=O$ and $B^2-5B-6I=O$, then among the two statements : (S1): $[(B-A)(B+A)]^T=\begin{bmatrix}13&15\\7&10\end{bmatrix}$ and (S2): $\det(\operatorname{adj}(A+B))=-5$,
stem.hi: माना $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\1&\alpha\end{bmatrix}$ और $B=\begin{bmatrix}3&3\\\beta&2\end{bmatrix}$ हैं। यदि $A^2-4A+I=O$ और $B^2-5B-6I=O$ हैं, तो दो कथनों : (S1): $[(B-A)(B+A)]^T=\begin{bmatrix}13&15\\7&10\end{bmatrix}$ तथा (S2): $\det(\operatorname{adj}(A+B))=-5$ में से,

feynman.en: A $2\times2$ matrix satisfies $M^2-(\text{trace})M+(\det)I=O$. Matching that with the given equations fixes $\alpha$ and $\beta$; then just multiply and check each statement.
feynman.hi: प्रत्येक $2\times2$ आव्यूह $M^2-(\text{trace})M+(\det)I=O$ को संतुष्ट करता है। दिए गए समीकरणों से तुलना करके $\alpha$ और $\beta$ मिलते हैं; फिर गुणा करके प्रत्येक कथन जाँचिए।

steps.en: Trace of $A$ is $1+\alpha=4$, so $\alpha=3$ (and $\det A=1$ checks). For $B$: $\det B=6-3\beta=-6$, so $\beta=4$.
steps.hi: $A$ का अनुरेख $1+\alpha=4$ है, अतः $\alpha=3$ (और $\det A=1$ मेल खाता है)। $B$ के लिए: $\det B=6-3\beta=-6$, अतः $\beta=4$।

steps.en: $(B-A)(B+A)=\begin{bmatrix}2&1\\3&-1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}4&5\\5&5\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}13&15\\7&10\end{bmatrix}$; its transpose is $\begin{bmatrix}13&7\\15&10\end{bmatrix}$, so (S1) is wrong.
steps.hi: $(B-A)(B+A)=\begin{bmatrix}2&1\\3&-1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}4&5\\5&5\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}13&15\\7&10\end{bmatrix}$; इसका परिवर्त $\begin{bmatrix}13&7\\15&10\end{bmatrix}$ है, अतः (S1) गलत है।

steps.en: $\det(A+B)=20-25=-5$, and for a $2\times2$ matrix $\det(\operatorname{adj}M)=\det M$, so (S2) is correct.
steps.hi: $\det(A+B)=20-25=-5$, और $2\times2$ आव्यूह के लिए $\det(\operatorname{adj}M)=\det M$, अतः (S2) सही है।

why.en: The product itself equals the given matrix; the statement asks for its transpose.
why.hi: गुणनफल स्वयं दिए गए आव्यूह के बराबर है; कथन उसका परिवर्त पूछता है।
